lines.text: The speaker's heart is faint, and he hears a cry asking whether the LORD is still in Zion.
The harvest and summer are over without rescue, and the speaker asks why there is no healing in Egypt.
The speaker wishes for a fountain of tears, and also for a traveler's lodge in the wilderness to leave his faithless people.
The LORD says a trusted brother can be relied on, and that He will refine and test His people.

wrong_details.wrong: a trusted brother can be relied on
wrong_details.true: do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily

lines.text: The LORD asks if He should not punish them, and says He will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble.
